about: The AP Environmental Science app pages. scripts/build-apenv.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in environmental-science/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApEnvCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/apenv-spec.md decision 2). tools[] are the twelve trainers of docs/apenv-spec.md section 6, pre-registered in Phase 0: page environmental-science/tools/<slug>.html, script environmental-science/assets/tools/<slug>.js, model environmental-science/assets/tools/math/<slug>.js (ApEnvMath.<camelSlug>), content environmental-science/data/tools/<slug>.json, validator scripts/lib/apenv-tool-checks/<slug>.mjs, test scripts/test/apenv-tool-<slug>.test.mjs (docs/apenv-architecture.md, "Tools"). topic is the tool's context topic: the tool is built only when its data file exists and that topic is published. FREE OR PREMIUM is set here and only here: a tool with "premium": "tools" is Premium; calculation-studio, energy-flow and cycles carry none and are free (docs/apenv-spec.md section 6, proposed; owner to confirm).

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Environmental science practice by unit, topic or skill: data, model and passage sets, calculations graded setup, answer and units, and answers made specific.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a skill, with data, model and passage sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your environmental science spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Unit tests and practice exams
apps.desc: Timed environmental science unit tests and full practice exams in the May 2027 format: 80 multiple-choice questions, then 3 free-response questions.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the May 2027 format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Environmental science free-response practice in the three exam question types, 10 points each, with a rubric, a full-credit sample and a check for your numbers.
apps.card: The three free-response question types, with 10-point rubrics and sample answers.

apps.title: Make it specific
apps.desc: Environmental science written answers made specific enough to score: hypotheses, variables, cause-and-effect chains and solutions fitted to the scenario.
apps.lede: Write the answer, then check it against the rubric and two model answers: one that earns the point and one that loses it.
apps.card: Hypotheses, chains and solutions specific enough to score, checked against a rubric.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Environmental science cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with timed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition environmental science flashcards built from the glossary and the formulas you must memorize, by unit and topic.
apps.card: Spaced-repetition cards from the glossary and the formulas.

apps.title: Trainers
apps.desc: Environmental science trainers: calculations, energy flow, cycles, populations, soil, climate, energy, air and water pollution, toxicity and climate change.
apps.card: Trainers and simulators, then the questions about what you saw.

apps.title: Your dashboard
apps.desc: Your environmental science mastery by unit, topic and skill, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and skill.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every environmental science lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For environmental science teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and Google Classroom sharing, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Calculation studio
tools.title: Calculation Studio
tools.desc: Every exam calculation as it is graded: type the setup with brackets and units, then the answer and its unit, each marked on its own with the slip named.
tools.blurb: Setup, answer and units, each graded the way the readers grade them.
tools.lede: Type the setup, then the answer and its units.

tools.name: Energy flow
tools.title: Energy Flow
tools.desc: Energy, biomass and number pyramids from one ecosystem: the 10% rule live, GPP, respiration and NPP, and a food web that responds when a species is removed.
tools.blurb: Move energy up a food chain and watch 90% leave as heat.
tools.lede: Change the producers' energy and watch each level respond.

tools.name: Cycles
tools.title: Biogeochemical Cycles
tools.desc: The carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus and water cycles as reservoirs and flows: tap a process to see what moves, then burn fuel, add fertilizer or clear a forest.
tools.blurb: Tap a process, then perturb a reservoir and watch the flows shift.
tools.lede: Tap a process to see what moves where.

tools.name: Population growth
tools.title: Population Growth
tools.desc: Exponential and logistic growth with r and K, overshoot and dieback, r- and K-selected traits, survivorship curves, and doubling time by the rule of 70.
tools.blurb: Grow a population to its carrying capacity, and past it.
tools.lede: Set the growth rate and the carrying capacity.

tools.name: Age structure
tools.title: Age Structure
tools.desc: Build a population pyramid, read fertility against replacement level, turn birth and death rates into a growth rate, and follow the demographic transition.
tools.blurb: Build a population pyramid and read its future.
tools.lede: Shape the pyramid, then predict the growth.

tools.name: Soil texture
tools.title: Soil Texture
tools.desc: Drag sand, silt and clay on the soil texture triangle and read the class; porosity, permeability and water-holding capacity; horizons, erosion and conservation.
tools.blurb: Find a soil on the texture triangle and see how it holds water.
tools.lede: Set sand, silt and clay and read the soil.

tools.name: Earth and climate
tools.title: Earth and Climate
tools.desc: Seasons from axial tilt, insolation by latitude, circulation cells and winds, the rain shadow, and El Niño and La Niña side by side.
tools.blurb: Move through the year with the tilted Earth, then switch between El Niño and La Niña.
tools.lede: Drag the date and watch the noon sun climb and fall.

tools.name: Energy chain
tools.title: Energy Chain
tools.desc: A power plant from fuel to outlet with the efficiency at each step, energy sources compared, and kWh, BTU and carbon dioxide calculations.
tools.blurb: Follow energy from fuel to outlet, step by step.
tools.lede: Pick a fuel and follow its energy to the outlet.

tools.name: Air pollution
tools.title: Air Pollution
tools.desc: Photochemical smog through a day, a thermal inversion on and off, acid rain from NOx and SOx, primary and secondary pollutants, and the fix for each.
tools.blurb: Run smog through a day and trap it under an inversion.
tools.lede: Move the clock and watch the pollutants rise and fall.

tools.name: Water pollution
tools.title: Water Pollution
tools.desc: The eutrophication chain step by step with a dissolved oxygen graph, thermal pollution and oxygen against temperature, and the stages of sewage treatment.
tools.blurb: Add fertilizer to a lake and follow the oxygen down.
tools.lede: Add nutrients and follow the chain to a dead zone.

tools.name: Dose and response
tools.title: Dose and Response
tools.desc: Read LD50 and the threshold dose off a dose-response curve, compare toxicity, and see bioaccumulation and biomagnification up a food chain.
tools.blurb: Read LD50 off a curve and watch a toxin climb a food chain.
tools.lede: Move along the curve and read the dose.

tools.name: Climate change
tools.title: Climate Change
tools.desc: The greenhouse effect beside the ozone layer, ocean acidification with pH, and sea level from thermal expansion and melting land ice, not sea ice.
tools.blurb: Keep the greenhouse effect and the ozone layer apart for good.
tools.lede: Add a gas and watch which radiation it stops.
